name: Microsoft Teams
author: Haripako
description: Teams dock-style control: hide/show, unread badge, call presence and auto-DND

barWidget.description: Teams icon with unread badge, call presence and hide/show

schema.label: Silence notifications while in a call
schema.description: Enable do-not-disturb automatically during Teams calls and restore it afterwards.

schema.label: Home workspace
schema.description: Workspace to return Teams to when unhiding. Leave empty to follow the active workspace.

schema.label: Launch command
schema.description: Command that starts Teams when it is not running. Empty launches the Chromium web app. Set it to a native client's command (for example teams-for-linux) to drive that instead.

schema.label: Window class fragment
schema.description: Substring matched against the window class to find the Teams window.

schema.label: Microphone owner
schema.description: Process name a capture stream must belong to before it counts as a Teams call. Teams runs inside Chromium, whose audio lives in a separate process from the window.

schema.label: Notifications plugin id
schema.description: Leave empty to detect the notification service automatically. Set it only if auto-detection picks the wrong one.
